text.tspan: Reported annual death rate from maternal conditions per 100,000 women and girls, based on official statistics
from each country. This includes late maternal deaths that occur up to 1 year after the end of pregnancy. Due to
limited reporting, figures are lower than the true number of maternal deaths.
Note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized. All deaths in a country may not have been
registered with a cause of death.
